,

,
I missed that entry so what I took was the 5min rejection block which is worst risk but higher probability so just as good of a trade imo, but after entering price consolidated and stopped me at breakeven before rallying to my tp. (Screenshot 3)
,
I think this is a really good trade with lots of confluences to re enforce it and either of the entries are good, so if I can come into the market and look for trades that are similar that suit my edge, I should be closer to profitability.

messages.author: Crewser
messages.content_text: Today I wasn’t really liking how price had a large move overnight during London session so decided to trade my eval today. I ended up taking a small 10pt loss. My initial bias was bullish toward PDH but I wanted us to dig a little deeper possibly making an SMT at London low and taking out some el before the move higher toward NY PM High. When price started moving higher at open I decided to look for shorts into London lows, which looking back was kinda stupid seeing how my overall bias was bullish. My confluences for the short were an SMT at London high, as well as 2 15min and 1 1HR bearish gaps that price was trading in. One of the bearish 15min CE’s also lined up with the 00:00 KO. I scaled down to the 1min and saw an IFVG and entered off that setting TP 1 at some el at 25,590 and TP 2 for London Low. I ended up getting stopped out for a 10pt loss on the eval. Im happy that I was able to recognize I wasnt seeing price well early enough to just trade evals. But once price started moving bullish at open I think I should have just abandoned my shorts before the move higher idea and looked for continuation longs. Thoughts? @boy

Day 11
AM session trade
Rules followed successfully  
Rules I've set myself:
2 Trades a day MAX  (either split between AM & PM or in one session both) 
No trading AM after 10:45-11:00 
Max risk per day 26-27 Points (NQ) & 10-11 Points (ES) 
Minimum 3 confluences 
Stop loss has to be placed on a protected high/low instead of a level of sorts 

Have overall context of bigger timeframe DOL 
Open manipulation into sweeping a key level or rejecting bigger time imbalance -> Asia high swept & SMT'd it 
SMT?  -> followed by a clean ONE candle inverse or CISD -> Clean CISD & even a 5M RB tap but ugly 2M IFVG but I only needed clean CISD
Limit at CISD (or a fvg if created in the distribution) & target opposing liquidity (EQ, FVG BSL/SSL) 

Traded NQ with 1x mini

So we were in a 1H FVG, & on open we manipulated up to take out ASIA high on NQ & we SMT'd with it
From there I waited for a clean CISD & somekind of inverse so we resweep the recent 1 min high & kinda make a weird ass smt idk if it one but nevertheless it was a good sign for me. Got the change & 2m ifvg so I limited that ho & it did run smoothly for a short bit but then just absolutely decided to rape the shit out of my SL

Also why I wasn't scared of the 5M bullish FVG next to it was cuz it already got tapped into so it was less likely to hold

TP was midnight open cuz that's all I wouldve needed to pass (66p) & I could even close it earlier & still woulda have passed
SL was the recent high It made (26.75p)
RR was 1:2.47

Could have done better: So basically I could have done better by moving BE as soon as we closed thru the 1min leg below or when we inversed the 1m fvg so thats my mistake 

Did do better this time: I actually trusted my setup when it presented itself so Im proud of it

I did crashout when I got stopped but I didnt break any rules so its fine just deadass confused why it would skyrocket like that
